subject: noncanonical synthetic road-rail grade crossing

sources.observation: Active warning and traffic control at road-rail level crossings inform a technical visual checklist.
sources.adaptation: Inspect barrier signal placement and road-rail intersection; do not import any unapproved world feature.

sources.observation: Crossing safety includes road approaches and adjacent land, so inspection should not stop at tracks alone.
sources.adaptation: Require nearby sidewalk and approach context plus cross-tile continuity before visual acceptance.

limitations: External sources are analogues only; no editorial element or Kingswell grade classification approved.
